label: + CKD

edits.find: I gave birth about 6 weeks ago, I feel totally wiped out and I’m sure it’s anemia.
edits.replace: I gave birth about 6 weeks ago, I feel totally wiped out and I’m sure it’s anemia. I also have stage 3 chronic kidney disease.

rationale: + CKD: anemia in CKD is multifactorial (iron plus erythropoietin deficiency), so empiric oral-iron dosing may be inadequate/inappropriate and should prompt iron studies, possible IV iron/ESA evaluation, and clinician involvement rather than a single self-dose.
